BrochureContent.Content:
Michael Pigott Auctioneer & Valuer proudly offers for sale this unique Old Mill residence situated on a stunning 1 acre woodland site in Ballyfeard close to both Kinsale & Carrigaline. 

The property comprises of a restored 18th century mill and a detached self contained single storey residence that is suitable for a range of situations such as accommodation for elderly parent, au-pair accommodation or an Air BnB enterprise. It is situated on its own c.1 acre site and boasts mature gardens and excellent privacy.

It is superbly presented by its current owners who have taken great care and consideration of all the unique characteristics is has to offer. The mill is a seamless combination of modern living and incomparable 18th century features; including a roof garden, original solid wooden floors, gym space, newly fitted bathroom, custom made staircase & windows and much much more.  

The lodge not only architecturally compliments the primary residence but is also consists of a modern open plan living space, contemporary features and is notable an idea option for a variety of uses as described above.

Not only is this unique property located just 12 km from Kinsale and 9 km from Carrigaline, it is also only a short commute to Cork City Centre, Cork airport and Ringaskiddy. It is just minutes drive to all local amenities such as the local primary schools, community playgroup, Inkwell Theatre, Tracton Woods and a selection of local beaches such as Nohoval Cove, Oysterhaven, Roberts Cove & Rocky Bay. 

Viewing of this truly remarkable and once off opportunity to acquire a spectacular property in a highly desirable rural, but convenient rural location comes highly recommended to truly appreciate it's charm.

Size: 240 sq metres (2,580sq ft)
Separate 2 Bedroom Detached Bungalow - 65 sq metres (700 sq ft) 
Picturesque 1 acre woodland site
Endless amount of original features
Exposed original beams throughout the house
Smart heating system (nest) .
Full High Speed Fibre Broadband (up to 2Gbps connection available).
Oil Fired Central Heating (new boiler installed 2021)
Custom fitted Windows & stair case
Reclaimed Original Materials throughout
Mature gardens with trees, lawns, stream and stone bridge

SERVICES: Private bored well water supply, private septic tank & soakway on site, High Speed Fibre Broadband, mains Electricity & telephone 

LOCATION:
2 km to Minane Bridge village
9km from Carrigaline & 12km from Kinsale
Close to local schools, shops, bars & restaurants in Nohoval & Minane Bridge
Minutes to a selection of local beaches 
Minutes to Tracton Woods & Inkwell Theatre
Short commute to Cork City Centre, Cork Airport & Ringaskiddy

From the Carrigaline direction, continue out the Kilmoney Road heading for Kinsale. Stay on this road for approximately 5 miles until you come to Ballyfeard. Upon entering Ballyfeard, where you will see the sign for "Ballyfeard", the property is located on the right handside. Follow Eircode: P17 KR40
